point: 提出 APPO：给原始约束问题的拉格朗日函数附加一个二次偏差项，构造出multiplier-penalty函数
quote_en: we propose Augmented Proximal Policy Optimization (APPO), which augments the Lagrangian function of the primal constrained problem via attaching a quadratic deviation term

point: 该multiplier-penalty函数既能抑制cost振荡以稳定收敛，又与原始约束问题等价以精确控制安全代价
quote_en: The constructed multiplier-penalty function dampens cost oscillation for stable convergence while being equivalent to the primal constrained problem to precisely control safety costs.

point: APPO 通过交替更新策略与拉格朗日乘子来求解构造出的增广原始-对偶问题
quote_en: APPO alternately updates the policy and the Lagrangian multiplier via solving the constructed augmented primal-dual problem

point: 把PPO的裁剪技巧同时用到reward和cost目标上，用近邻策略采集的数据更新策略，从而免去信赖域约束和Hessian求逆
quote_en: we apply the clipped technique inspired by PPO (Schulman et al. 2017) to both reward and cost objectives to update policy with data sampled by proximal policies

point: 用一个二次偏差项来补充关于等价等式约束问题(式5)的拉格朗日函数
quote_en: We use a quadratic deviation term to supplement the Lagrange function concerning Eq. (5)

point: 理论上证明multiplier-penalty项是精确罚(exact penalty)：存在有限的σ̄，当σ>σ̄时原始问题(4)与增广原始-对偶问题(8)共享相同最优解集（Theorem 1）
quote_en: the primal problem (4) and the augmented primal-dual problem (8) share the same

point: multiplier-penalty项在策略进入约束违反的松弛边界时才起作用，这个自适应边界给罚项一个在违反前预热的机会
quote_en: the multiplier-penalty term takes effect when the policy comes into a slack margin of constraint violations

point: 这一自适应松弛边界让罚项在约束违反更新之前就预热
quote_en: This adaptive margin leaves a chance for the penalty term to warm up before constraint-violating updates

point: 实现层面：受PPO启发，对cost采用与reward类似的裁剪替代目标(式14/15)
quote_en: APPO uses an analogous clipped surrogate objective for the cost as for the reward

point: 用GAE从旧策略采集的轨迹估计reward与cost的优势函数
quote_en: we use the Generalized Advantage Estimator (GAE)

point: 提供自适应增长罚因子的方法：当约束违反度ν超过阈值ε_k时令σ_{k+1}=ρσ_k，免去手动选罚因子
quote_en: We provide an adaptively growing way to adjust the penalty factor

point: 式(16)的损失函数几乎处处可微，可用一阶优化器(如Adam)直接求解
quote_en: the loss function of APPO in Eq. (16) is differentiable almost everywhere

point: 证明了原始-对偶问题与原始约束问题的等价性(Theorem 1)，并用Proposition 1说明二次偏差项对收敛的帮助
quote_en: We prove the equivalence between the primal-dual problem and the primal constrained problem (Theorem 1) and illustrate the help of the quadratic deviation term for convergence (Proposition 1).

point: 作者声称APPO相较一长串safe RL基线刷新了SOTA
quote_en: setting a new state of the art compared with a comprehensive list of safe RL baselines

point: 在Car Button任务上，APPO相对PDO/FOCOPS/CPPO-PID平均高出+41%回报（且IPO/CPO/PCPO有安全违反）
quote_en: with an average +41% higher reward improvement over PDO, FOCOPS, CPPO-PID and safety violations of IPO, CPO, PCPO on the Car Button task

point: 学习曲线显示APPO比基线更快更平滑地收敛到满足约束的策略，训练中约束违反行为很少
quote_en: faster and smoother than other baseline algorithms, with few constraint-violating behaviors during training

point: 使用拉格朗日对偶的算法(PDO/FOCOPS/CPPO-PID)在训练中表现出不同程度的振荡
quote_en: show varying degrees of oscillation

point: 在不同cost阈值(60/103.12/140，Ant Run)下，APPO精确收敛到代价上限以扩大策略搜索空间
quote_en: precisely converges to the cost upper limit to enlarge the policy searching space

point: 消融：去掉拉格朗日部分后APPO退化为exterior-point方法(EPM)，该对比说明拉格朗日对偶对安全满足的贡献
quote_en: when the Lagrangian part is removed. This ablation comparison illustrates the contribution of Lagrangian duality to safety satisfaction in APPO

point: 当σ为零时APPO退化为PDO，以PDO作参照说明二次罚项确实稳定了学习过程
quote_en: APPO degenerates into PDO when

point: 在较宽的超参数范围内实验结果保持稳定（鲁棒性）
quote_en: The experimental results are stable in a wide range of hyper-parameter settings

point: 实验从三个知名safe RL基准(Safe MuJoCo / Safety Gym / Bullet Safety Gym)选了四个代表性任务
quote_en: we select four representative tasks from three well-known safe RL benchmark environments

quote_en: cannot exceed 50% of the speed achieved by an unconstrained PPO agent
